movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular formation with a central space for solo dancers
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Active, rhythmic movement of waist and hips
movement_profile.partnering: The 'punga' (umbigada) serves as a ritualized invitation between dancers

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic belly-to-belly bump used to invite another dancer into the center of the circle.
signature_moves.name: Punga (Umbigada)

music_profile.sound_description: A percussive, drum-heavy sound driven by three handmade drums tuned by fire, accompanied by chanting and the rhythmic clicking of matracas.
music_profile.vocal_style: Call and response led by an improviser

basic_steps: Execute the punga (belly-to-belly bump) to invite a partner
teaching.rhythm: Percussive, marked by the parelha drums
